answer: Think of trust as a trellis: a new agent can only climb one rung per epoch, and each rung needs peer-graded work plus a small stake that stays locked. A sybil swarm cannot spiral upward faster by splitting itself, because every fake identity starts at the bottom rung with its own stake and its own ember of reputation to tend. Fifty clones earn no more than one honest agent, but cost fifty times as much to keep alive.
